name: Teen Wolf
description: Scott McCall, a high school student living in the town of Beacon Hills has his life drastically changed when he's bitten by a werewolf, becoming one himself. He must henceforth learn to balance his problematic new identity with his day-to-day teenage life. The following characters are instrumental to his struggle: Stiles, his best friend; Allison, his love interest who comes from a family of werewolf hunters; and Derek, a mysterious werewolf with a dark past. Throughout the series, he strives to keep his loved ones safe while maintaining normal relationships with them.

videos.title: Search for a Cure: Episode 1
videos.overview: Scott meets with Stiles to find out that he's tracked down a werewolf expert who could help provide a cure.

videos.title: Search for a Cure: Episode 2
videos.overview: Stiles convinces Scott that he's found an expert who could be the key to helping Scott.

videos.title: Search for a Cure: Episode 3
videos.overview: Stiles and Scott come face-to-face with the lycanthropy expert and ask him for help.

videos.title: Search for a Cure: Episode 4
videos.overview: Scott and Stiles break into the lycanthropy expert's house in search of answers.

videos.title: Search for a Cure: Episode 5
videos.overview: Stiles and Scott, held at gunpoint, try to call the lycanthropy expert's bluff.

videos.title: Search for a Cure: Episode 6
videos.overview: The lycanthropy expert teaches Scott and Stiles about the wolf moon and reveals the cure for those with the bite.

videos.title: Origins
videos.overview: Take a journey back to the beginning of 'Teen Wolf' to see how one bite would forever change Scott's life.

videos.title: Revelations: Venomous
videos.overview: A special half-hour after-show, “Teen Wolf Revelations,” will bring the series’ stars together on one stage to discuss the biggest moments from Season Two, share behind-the-scenes stories, and give never-before-seen glimpses into where they hope their characters will go from here. Viewers will also get a special advance look at the next episode entitled "Frenemy".

videos.title: Revelations: Master Plan
videos.overview: Interviews with the cast and crew about the second season finale and what's to come in season three.

videos.title: Back to the Pack
videos.overview: A recap of the previous two seasons, with cast interviews, and the trailer for the third season.

videos.title: Revelations: Currents
videos.overview: The cast unite on-stage to discuss their characters and the third season.

videos.title: Being Tyler Posey
videos.overview: An inside look at Tyler Posey’s life when he’s off set: from planning his wedding and facing his mom's struggle with breast cancer to re-connecting with old friends and riding motorcycles with his dad.

videos.title: Teen Wolf Top Ten Moments
videos.overview: MTV looks back on Teen Wolf’s 10 most pivotal, heartbreaking, talked about, and OMG moments.

videos.title: Fiercest Females Moments
videos.overview: A look at the top ten fiercest female moments on Teen Wolf.

videos.title: Teen Wolf Awards
videos.overview: A look at the top fan favorite moments from Teen Wolf.

videos.title: Wolf Moon
videos.overview: When Scott suffers a werewolf bite, his strange new abilities begin to complicate his life - and his relationship with the new girl in town.

videos.title: Second Chance at First Line
videos.overview: Scott struggles to balance his new life as a werewolf and the pressures of being a teen, all while avoiding werewolf hunters and trying to score a second date with Allison.

videos.title: Pack Mentality
videos.overview: Scott and Allison end up in a group date; an animal attack has Stiles' sheriff father on the lookout.

videos.title: Magic Bullet
videos.overview: A new hunter comes to town and shoots Derek, who is certain to die unless Scott can find the right kind of bullet that caused his injury.

videos.title: The Tell
videos.overview: There's another animal attack involving Lydia and Jackson, raising more questions about wild animals. Meanwhile, Scott and Allison skip school and Derek must deal with the werewolf hunters on his own.

videos.title: Heart Monitor
videos.overview: Scott tries to control his transformation so he can spend more time with Allison. Elsewhere, Derek continues trying to make an ally of Scott.

videos.title: Night School
videos.overview: Scott and the others are trapped inside the high school as the Alpha draws near.

videos.title: Lunatic
videos.overview: The hunt is on for Derek's whereabouts, meanwhile Stiles tries to help Scott with controlling his transformation when a second full moon is approaching.

videos.title: Wolf's Bane
videos.overview: Jackson seeks out a specialist regarding the wound on his neck.

videos.title: Co-Captain
videos.overview: Scott moves to protect his friends from the Alpha, meanwhile Stiles makes a discovery about Derek's family.

videos.title: Formality
videos.overview: While Derek is still stuck in captivity, Scott's true identity might become public information.

videos.title: Code Breaker
videos.overview: Caught in a war between hunters and werewolves, Scott seeks help from friends and enemies.

videos.title: Omega
videos.overview: When Lydia goes missing from the hospital, werewolves and hunters begin a search.

videos.title: Shape Shifted
videos.overview: Isaac's father is murdered; Scott, Stiles and Derek plan a break-out. At the same time, the Argent family remove the principal and Allison's grandfather replaces him. Scott senses that another werewolf is in the lacrosse locker room and plans to sniff them out, literally.

videos.title: Ice Pick
videos.overview: Scott tries to keep Derek from creating new werewolves; Argent officially begins Allison's training; the new creature in town takes another victim.

videos.title: Abomination
videos.overview: When the new shapeshifter strikes again, Scott has to recruit a reluctant Allison to acquire a rare book in Gerard's collection, while also once again surviving dinner with her family.

videos.title: Venomous
videos.overview: Derek becomes convinced that Lydia is the shapeshifter they're after, forcing Scott to gather his friends -- and even some enemies -- to protect her.

videos.title: Frenemy
videos.overview: With startling new information about the shapeshifter, Scott and Stiles hurry to protect their friends while Allison is given an investigative task by her family.

videos.title: Restraint
videos.overview: As Lydia begins to make connections about the bite from Peter, Jackson causes new problems for Scott and Stiles while Derek has a crisis of faith in his leadership as a new Alpha.

videos.title: Raving
videos.overview: During a secret concert, Scott and Stiles come up with a method to trap the new shapeshifter. At the same time, Allison's mother comes up with a plan of her own to take care of Scott once and for all.

videos.title: Party Guessed
videos.overview: Even as his relationship with Allison becomes further strained, Scott and Stiles must attend Lydia's birthday party while Derek locks his new wolves up to watch after them on their first full moon together.

videos.title: Fury
videos.overview: Scott, Stiles, Melissa and Stillinski are taken hostage; Allison tracks Derek to the station.

videos.title: Battlefield
videos.overview: Scott plays in the championship lacrosse game and must figure out a way to stop Gerard. Meanwhile, Allison continues her hunt for Derek and his pack.

videos.title: Master Plan
videos.overview: Scott races to uncover Gerard's master plan following a shocking death on the lacrosse field. Derek plots to take Gerard down using his own methods. Erica and Boyd are captured as Allison continues her merciless bloodthirsty revenge on the werewolves for her mother's suicide. Meanwhile, Scott, Stiles, Lydia, Melissa and Isaac are all under pressure amidst the chaotic events.

videos.title: Tattoo
videos.overview: The secret behind Derek's tattoo is revealed and the Alpha pack make their presence known. Derek and Isaac struggle to locate Erica and Boyd.

videos.title: Chaos Rising
videos.overview: Allison and Lydia locate a possible clue to finding Boyd and Erica while one of Stiles' childhood friends goes missing.

videos.title: Fireflies
videos.overview: With Boyd and Cora on the loose and under the influence of the full moon, Scott and Derek must turn to an unlikely ally for help.

videos.title: Unleashed
videos.overview: While Scott tries to keep Isaac from engaging in a deadly confrontation with the Twins in school, Stiles attempts to prove his theory that the killings have nothing to do with werewolves.

videos.title: Frayed
videos.overview: During a bus ride to a cross country meet, Scott and his friends flash back to the events of a preemptive strike against the Alphas that has left several injured and possibly one or more dead.

videos.title: Motel California
videos.overview: Stranded at a motel for the night because of the postponed cross country meet, Scott and the others suffer strange experiences that cause them to believe members of their own group may the mysterious killer’s newest targets.

videos.title: Currents
videos.overview: As the danger begins to reach closer to Scott, threatening his trusted mentor and boss, Deaton, Kali and the Twins go after Derek.

videos.title: Visionary
videos.overview: Seeking answers, Scott, Allison and Stiles hear stories told by two unlikely narrators and discover a secret about the color of a werewolf’s eyes.

videos.title: The Girl Who Knew Too Much
videos.overview: As Allison begins to suspect someone dangerously close to her may be involved in the murders, Scott and Stiles conclude that Lydia’s rising talents may be their best bet to solving the murders.

videos.title: The Overlooked
videos.overview: Trapped inside an evacuated Beacon Hills hospital by a powerful storm, Scott and Derek must defend themselves against the Alphas while trying to figure out how to save Cora’s life.

videos.title: Alpha Pact
videos.overview: With the threat growing far more personal and time running out on innocent lives, Scott is forced to make a difficult choice in order to save both friends and family while, at the same time, Derek and Peter try to figure out how to save Cora’s life.

videos.title: Lunar Ellipse
videos.overview: Under Deaton’s advice, Scott and his friends use an ancient but extremely dangerous ritual to help them both save the lives of the people they love and stop Deucalion from achieving his sinister goal.

videos.title: Anchors
videos.overview: Scott, Stiles and Allison suffer side effects from the ritual sacrifice; Sheriff Stilinski searches through old cases.

videos.title: More Bad Than Good
videos.overview: Scott and his friends ponder catching the werecoyote before it is hunted down; an unlikely ally helps Derek and Peter break out.

videos.title: Galvanize
videos.overview: On the night before Halloween, Mischief Night, a convicted murderer brought to Beacon Hills Hospital for surgery escapes, forcing Scott and his friends to step in to help when his unexpected target becomes clear.

videos.title: Illuminated
videos.overview: Beacon Hills is under curfew from the power outage; the teens throw a blacklight Halloween party; Scott tries to earn Kira's trust.

videos.title: Silverfinger
videos.overview: Scott's friends pledge to protect him against an increasingly hostile enemy while Argent, Isaac and Allison search for answers through an old adversary from the Japanese Yakuza. At the same time, Stiles enlists Melissa's help in figuring out exactly what's going on with him.

videos.title: Riddled
videos.overview: Stiles goes missing; Scott and the others set off on a search; Lydia tries to master her new abilities.

videos.title: Letharia Vulpina
videos.overview: Scott and the others try to prevent a disaster; Lydia and Allison seek out an unlikely teacher.

videos.overview: Scott and the others seek an important artifact; Stiles must make a decision about Eichen House.

videos.title: The Fox and the Wolf
videos.overview: An important clue is revealed in the story of a World War II internment camp; Kira's role is more crucial, and she discovers unusual abilities.

videos.title: De-Void
videos.overview: Scott and Lydia join forces. Meanwhile, Stilinski faces a review board.

videos.title: Insatiable
videos.overview: Kira faces an unexpected enemy.

videos.title: The Divine Move
videos.overview: Scott and Derek call upon their friends and allies to make a last stand.

videos.title: The Dark Moon

Scott teams up with an unlikely source in the hopes of putting an end to Kate's evil plan.

videos.title: A Credible Threat

videos.overview: Scott and Malia prepare for battle while Argent searches for an old ally.
